items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Charlie Elder was responsible for that band coming there.

ctx.x: I forget the bass player. I don't know what a little. I didn't know Louis Cantrell played in Chicago. Heck yes. But that band. Charlie Elder was responsible for that band coming there. They played at a place in Chicago on Madison Street called El Sonia.
Yeah, I heard about that. And they come from El Sonia to the Pekin and I come from Dreamland.
